programmes.d: Four wealthy one-percenters are left for dead outside a hospital emergency room in a twisty murder case that leads through an impossible list of suspects.
Sharon's ex, Jack (TOM BERENGER), is back again, defending a man who is attempting to withdraw a confession in the murder of his wife. Rusty interviews Slider (GARRETT COFFEY).
A murder during the taping of a reality competition show pitting married couples against each other has a profound effect on Sanchez, bringing back memories of his late wife.
The team investigates a follow-up attack on a victim of road rage. As Thanksgiving approaches, Flynn suffers a setback. Rusty gets the interview with Slider (GARRETT COFFEY).
Sharon and team investigate the murder of a young man who could afford a high-end apartment without visible means of support. Flynn endures an overly cheerful physical therapist.
An NCIS agent has been murdered while investigating a case and the team's job is to find out what happened. (TV-PG)

A marine goes missing after a date with a reporter. During the investigation, the team discovers that three former members of his unit are dead and suspect the unit commander to be a serial killer. (TV-PG)
When a body of a murdered marine is found in the forest, the investigation leads to the local militia and a weapon deal gone wrong. (TV-PG)
Gibbs and his team investigate the death of a SEAL that occurred during a training exercise.(TV-PG)
The terrorist who previously held a part of the NCIS team hostage, returns with a plan to attack the President. (TV-PG)
When the wife and 9-year-old blind daughter of a Navy captain are kidnapped, Gibbs and his team are faced with a unique challenge. (TV-PG)

The Major Crimes team searches for a professional baseball player's daughter who is missing, and the investigation leads them to the very limits of the justice system.
Sharon and the team track an unhinged killer making his own film, with his victims as the stars. A new romance finds wings.
A gun used in a murder is connected to the most troubling series of unsolved homicides in LAPD history. Captain Raydor and the rest of her division attempt to solve the mystery.
Sharon and Major Crimes rush to capitalize on a shocking discovery made in a church. Steph (JULIE ANN EMERY) and Sanchez's connection grows as they bond over lost loved ones.
With another victim found, Sharon focuses on former LAPD detective Mark Hickman (JASON GEDRICK). Fritz (JON TENNEY) and his team help the LAPD show up in force at a funeral.
More information pours in about victims from the past and how they tie to the murders of the present. Lt. Cooper (MALCOM-JAMAL WARNER) and Amy Sykes get caught in a gun fight.
In the gripping season finale, the threads of seven murders are tied together as the video wire on Reverend Price (TARIK LOWE) elicits admissions, narrowing the field of suspects.
